title: LangChain
description: Documented public agent framework (LangChain (open source)) for the Agent Framework Foundry capability area.
body:
LangChain is a documented agent framework from LangChain (open source). The dominant open framework for chaining LLM calls with tools, memory, and retrieval into multi-step agents.

How it works: It works by having each agent vote with a confidence weight and taking the confidence-weighted winner as the consensus.

Documented uses of this capability area include neural architecture search, automated hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation leaderboards, and AI safety red-teaming.

body:

How it works: It works by computing cosine similarity between the query vector and each stored document vector, returning the top matches.
